notes.title: Big Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey there!

This is a pretty big announcement. The game will be delayed for a long time! Now, how long? We don't know. We aren't going to be releasing the game in Early Access but instead as a fully complete game! We feel that there should be a full story you can experience right away. This is just a quick but pretty big announcement saying this!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/peeveRpU8W

Thank you all for reading!

notes.title: 2 Week Delay for Early Access!
notes.content:
Hey there!

We just wanted to make this announcement saying that we are going to be delaying the game for 2 weeks! But, why?

Well, there are some bugs that we want to fix of course. We want to add more to the story as well which is a big one. But we want to add a feature that is game-changing.

We want to add a player level. This player level will be increased based on how many tasks you do, if you die, and how many games you play of course. 

Just wanted to make this quick announcement! The giveaway is still going on in the discord server!
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/peeveRpU8W

Thank you all for reading!

notes.title: 5 Days Until Release, Escape Mode Showcase, and Giveaway!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We wanted to make this quick announcement telling you that there are just 5 days until Deep Excavation becomes available on Steam in Early Access! We have created a youtube video showcasing Escape Mode.
This video is a 5 and a half minute video having the developer, LegacyJacob, play through it until he escapes! Now, what is Escape Mode?

Escape mode is a single-player or multiplayer game mode. Your goal is to complete the number of tasks given and escape! But watch out, there are traps that can give away your location if you are not careful enough! If a trap is set, the noise will play allowing a creature that was randomly spawned, to hear it. The creature will most likely, depending on who it is, will go to the location! Attempt to hide either behind objects or on top of them!

Here is the video showcasing Escape Mode!

[previewyoutube=zm0mmB8Oo54;full][/previewyoutube]

You have made it past all that, so here is the giveaway! We are giving away 5 free game keys! If you want to enter, join the discord below and go to the Giveaway channel!

Discord: https://discord.com/invite/peeveRpU8W
We are excited about the release and hope you are too! Hope to see you in-game!
